rx-analyst.purpose: Architecture mapping, code reading, incident investigation, evidence-based reporting
rx-analyst.networkException: explicit human authorization for a specific allowlisted read, per run
rx-analyst.mcp: read-only tools only, when configured; none declared by this repo's example profiles

rx-developer.purpose: Implement local code changes and run tests
rx-developer.networkException: approved dependency restore or approved local integration only
rx-developer.mcp: inherits user/system MCP config; none added by this repo's example profiles
writableRoots: default cwd-scoped workspace-write root only — no additional roots declared
prohibited: destructive git (reset --hard, clean -f*, checkout -- overwrite, push)

rx-security.purpose: Adversarial review of source, configuration, dependencies, threat boundaries
rx-security.mcp: read-only security/advisory sources only, when configured; none declared by this repo's example profiles
prohibited: active scanning outside authorized local fixtures

rx-ci.networkException: none — a trusted CI architecture would supply capability outside untrusted code execution; not configured in this repo
rx-ci.mcp: none permitted (no interactive-auth or write-capable MCP servers)
